observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor grassy area in a village setting with traditional bamboo and thatched-roof longhouses visible in the background, daytime
observation.dancers: mixed group of about ten men and women in traditional attire, forming a circle
observation.formation_and_space: group dances in a circle formation, moving in a circular path around the space
observation.posture: upright torso with slight forward lean during low steps, knees bent and springing with weight transferring on each beat
observation.footwork: stepping sideways with small jumps and heel lifts, synchronized to the beat; exact foot placement details cannot be seen due to grass and clothing
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held out to the sides holding wrapped shawls/blankets that flutter as they move; one man stands outside playing a drum and another makes rhythmic signals
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal hip movement, torso bobs up and down with the knee bends
observation.partnering: none, dancers move independently in the circle
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low level maintained with small hopping jumps and periodic crouching/squatting movements while turning
observation.costume_and_props: traditional woven wrap-around skirts and shawls/blankets with horizontal stripes in black, white, and red; patterned headbands; drum played by a standing performer
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement on the ground is obscured by grass and long garments; footwork details between low-resolution frames are uncertain

signature_moments.what: Dancers form a circle holding striped blankets across their shoulders and step rhythmically while hopping in unison.
Dancers crouch low while stepping sideways in a circle, holding their blankets spread wide.
Group dips down low simultaneously with knees bent deep, then rises back to a bounce step.
Dancers sweep their blankets outward and pivot while hopping on each beat.
